cloud_api.label: Label
add_key.title: 🔑 Add API Key
add_key.label: Label
cloud_api.cap_none_hint: This provider has a card but nothing uses its key yet.
cloud_api.unverified_hint: Stored and active, but never confirmed with a real call. Click Test.
cloud_api.test_image_hint: Draw one test image with exactly this key (no switching to another key or provider)
add_key.email_label: Email (only for a Global API Key)
add_key.account_required: Account ID is required for Cloudflare.
add_key.cloudflare_hint: Paste an API Token (Bearer). For a Global API Key, also fill in Email.
models.src_api: List fetched from the provider's API at {when}.
models.src_builtin: Shipped default list — may be outdated. Click "Fetch from API" to update.
cloud_api.muse_hint: Muse has no API key: TubeCLI types into muse.ai inside a browser profile that is signed in to it. Pick that profile. A closed profile opens in the background on the first request. Each account answers one request at a time — add more accounts below to draw several pictures at once.
cloud_api.muse_turns_hint: TubeCLI reuses one Muse side chat for this many requests, then starts a new one.
cloud_api.muse_cleared: Muse is turned off (no browser profile).
cloud_api.muse_pick_first: Pick the browser profile first, then save.
cloud_api.muse_closed: Profile {profile} is closed — it opens in the background on the first request.
cloud_api.muse_not_signed: ❌ {profile} is not signed in to muse.ai — open the profile, sign in to muse.ai, then check again.
cloud_api.muse_extra_hint: Tick other browser profiles, each signed in to a different muse.ai account. Requests are spread over all accounts — 3 accounts draw 3 pictures at once.
cloud_api.muse_lanes_hint: Keep 1 to be safe. 2 worked in a short test, but Muse may slow down or flag an account that sends many requests at once.
cloud_api.muse_saved_pool: Saved — Muse uses {profile} and {n} more account(s).
cloud_api.muse_remotes_hint: Other machines running TubeCLI with their own Muse accounts, one per line, as many as you like: machine address | node key | seats. The plain address is enough (https://vps1.tubecreate.com); /api/v1/muse is added for you. Each node adds that many parallel seats; the browsers run there, not here.
cloud_api.pv_badge_remote_only: Working via {n} other machine(s) · {s} at once
cloud_api.pv_badge_unchecked: Not checked yet · press Check sign-ins
cloud_api.pv_sub_muse: Muse has no API key. TubeCLI uses browser profiles on this machine that are already signed in to muse.ai. Pick which profiles to use, say how many videos may run at once, and borrow accounts from other machines if you have them. Nothing changes until you press Save.
cloud_api.pv_sub_endpoint: Keys are managed on the provider card. Here you set where this provider runs and which model names TubeCLI may use.
cloud_api.pv_sub_key: Keys are managed on the provider card. Here you choose which model names TubeCLI may use.
cloud_api.pv_models_intro: Model names TubeCLI may ask this provider for. Add one by hand or fetch the current list from the provider.
cloud_api.pv_models_intro_muse: Muse has one text model and one image model. You rarely need to change this list.
cloud_api.pv_acc_remote_only: No browser profile on this machine. Videos run on {n} other machine(s), {s} at once. Switch on a profile here only if this machine has a browser signed in to muse.ai.
cloud_api.pv_acc_none: No profile is switched on yet. Switch on a profile that is signed in to muse.ai,
cloud_api.pv_acc_hint: Switch on every profile that is signed in to muse.ai. One is the main profile; the others run in parallel.
cloud_api.pv_acc_note: Each profile should be a different muse.ai account. Two profiles on one account do not make it faster.
cloud_api.pv_acc_more: {n} more profiles that are not switched on
cloud_api.pv_side_local: {n} account(s) on this machine × {l} at a time
cloud_api.pv_side_no_test: Not tested yet · press Test chat
cloud_api.pv_help_1: Sign in to muse.ai inside a browser profile (Browser page).
cloud_api.pv_help_3: Press Test chat and wait for «OK».
cloud_api.pv_help_4: Press Save. Nothing changes until you do.
cloud_api.pv_speed_hint: Add another machine that has its own Muse accounts. You need its address and the node key it made.
cloud_api.pv_lanes_title: How many videos at once, per account?
cloud_api.pv_lanes_hint: Keep 1 to be safe. 2 worked in a short test, but Muse may slow down or flag an account that sends many requests at once.
cloud_api.pv_lanes_math: {a} account(s) × {l} = {n} here, plus {r} on other machines = {t} at once.
cloud_api.pv_turns_hint: How many requests share one muse.ai chat before a fresh one is opened. The default is fine.
cloud_api.pv_mach_title: Other machines that lend their Muse accounts
cloud_api.pv_mach_hint: Each machine runs TubeCLI with its own signed-in Muse accounts. Add its address and the node key it made, and its accounts join yours.
cloud_api.pv_add_key_ph: paste the key that machine made
cloud_api.pv_add_hint: The plain address is enough (https://vps2.tubecreate.com). The node key is not a password: the other machine makes it under Other machines → This machine's node key. Seats = how many videos to send that machine at once, usually its number of signed-in accounts.
cloud_api.pv_key_hint: Give it to another machine so it can borrow the accounts above. The full key is shown only when it is made.
cloud_api.pv_key_confirm: Make a new key? Machines using the old key will stop until you give them the new one.
cloud_api.pv_key_made: Copy it now and paste it on the other machine. It will not be shown again.
cloud_api.pv_how_1: On the machine that HAS the Muse accounts: press Make key here and copy it.
cloud_api.pv_how_2: On the machine that wants to borrow: add that machine's address and the key under Add a machine.
cloud_api.pv_how_3: Press Test and add, then Save. Its seats join the count on the Accounts tab.
cloud_api.pv_test_running: Sending «Reply with the single word OK» through your pool…
cloud_api.pv_opened: {name} opened in a window. Sign in to muse.ai there, then press Check sign-ins.
cloud_api.pv_close_unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Close without saving?
cloud_api.muse_node_key_hint: Lets another TubeCLI use this machine's Muse accounts through /api/v1/muse/v1/*. Make a key, then paste it into that machine's remote-node line.
cloud_api.muse_node_key_made: Node key made and saved — copy it now, it is shown only once.
